directory.name: Dude'Z Woodfired Pizza
directory.note: Wood-fired pizzeria on Fuhrman Ave E in Eastlake, run by two brothers and a cousin, serving New York-style pies from a wood oven.

directory.name: Elemental Pizza
directory.note: Wood-fired pizzeria founded in 2012 at University Village, now with a second Seattle location downtown near Columbia Center plus a mobile catering oven.
directory.address: 2634 NE University Village St, Seattle, WA 98105

directory.name: Eyman's Pizza
directory.note: Halal pizzeria on Martin Luther King Jr Way S making hand-stretched dough and scratch tomato sauce to order, with no pork in the kitchen.
directory.address: 6711 Martin Luther King Jr Way S, Seattle, WA 98118

directory.name: Georgetown Pizza & Arcade
directory.note: Georgetown pizza-and-pinball bar serving square pizzas by the slice or whole pie alongside 20+ arcade and pinball machines.

directory.name: Good Shape Pizza
directory.note: Neapolitan-leaning pizzeria that outgrew its pop-up run (Add-A-Ball, Chuck's Hop Shop, Oddfellows Cafe) to become a permanent kitchen inside Jupiter Bar in Belltown; its permit address is not the public storefront.

directory.name: In Pizza We Crust
directory.note: Family-run wood-fired pizzeria that grew from a 2019 Bellevue food truck into a permanent shop in West Seattle's Admiral Junction, opened in the former Swinery space.

candidateReview.name: Domani Pizzeria & Restaurant
candidateReview.note: Despite the name, Domani is a Mediterranean/Italian neighborhood restaurant on Queen Anne Ave N where fresh pasta, salads and sandwiches get equal billing with pizza — not a pizza-forward concept.

candidateReview.name: G.H Pasta & Pizza West Seattle
candidateReview.note: West Seattle restaurant from General Harvest Restaurants built around house-extruded pasta as its stated priority, with a smaller selection of 12-inch pizzas as a secondary offering — not a pizza-forward concept.

candidateReview.name: In Pizza We Crust LLC - Kc507
candidateReview.note: Same address (3207 California Ave SW) and business as 'In Pizza We Crust' — a second King County permit registration for the same wood-fired pizzeria, not a separate business.
